items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I had some bad boys playing with me... See, Carl and them, they wanted to be the outstanding guy.

ctx.x: I had some bad boys playing with me. I had some bad boys playing with me. And well that's right, all of them could play. I wouldn't hide nobody. See, Carl and them, they wanted to be the outstanding guy. I didn't care how much you played, as long as you played right. You understand what I mean? Of course now people like in these late years like George Lewis and them, well they come about like cuckoos and that bunch come about. Well the times that I'm telling you about these fellas, they was good musicians in…
Was George Lewis old fashioned and good boy with that old time in him?
